definitions.perturb: G_q -> G_q a_q exp(i eps_q) exp(+i 2 pi (f - f_ref) dtau_q), f_ref = 0 uncalibrated, f0 calibrated
definitions.draws: independent uniform per channel (all four for phase and amplitude; delay error e_q * q * tau_PhC so channel 0 has none, 'abs' variant e_q (N_q + 6) tau_PhC)
definitions.deterministic: phase/amplitude: linear ramp +-level end to end; delay: every channel scaled by (1 + level) in relative delay
definitions.metrics: max/rms |theta_peak - 30 deg| over mask_common; gain loss (positive = loss) = -min_f 10 log10(p/p_nom); eff_loss = same at fixed input power (post hoc); strongest = max over band of the strongest other lobe (dB re peak); R_squint = max_err / max_err(fixed phase)
definitions.budget: largest half-width with P95 (or median) of max |pointing error| (incl. nominal) <= limit, linear interpolation; system-level tolerance estimate, not a fabrication specification
